name: Mga Ilog at Estero sa Kalakhang Maynila
title: Mga Ilog at Estero sa Kalakhang Maynila
description: Talaan ng mga ilog, sapa at estero sa Kalakhang Maynila kasama ang paglalarawan ng pinagmumulan at dinadaanan ng tubig.

rows.name: Ilog Alabang
rows.description: Nagmumula ang tubig sa Alabang (hanggang Ayala Alabang Village at Festival Supermall). Nagtatapos sa Laguna de Bay galing Ilog Pasong Diablo.

rows.name: Sapa ng Amorsolo
rows.description: Nagmumula ang tubig sa Kalye Amorsolo sa Makati mula sa paligid ng Makati Medical Center. Isang seksyon ang tinayuan ng rampa para sa Manila Skyway. Dumadaan sa San Lorenzo Village at Simbahan ng Don Bosco. Nagtatapos sa Estero de Tripa de Gallina.

rows.name: Sapa ng Anaran
rows.description: Lungsod ng Quezon.

rows.name: Sapa ng Balaba
rows.description: Lungsod ng Quezon.

rows.name: Balingasa Creek
rows.description: Lungsod ng Quezon. Nagtatapos sa Ilog San Francisco.

rows.name: Batasan River
rows.description: Nagmumula ang tubig sa Malabon at Navotas. Nagtatapos sa Ilog Tanza na nagpapatuloy papuntang Look ng Maynila sa pamamagitan ng Ilog Tangos.

rows.name: Bayan Creek
rows.description: Lungsod ng Quezon.

rows.name: Bayanan Creek
rows.description: Nagmumula ang tubig sa Muntinlupa. Nagtatapos sa Laguna de Bay.

rows.name: Buwaya Creek
rows.description: Project 4, Lungsod ng Quezon.

rows.name: Campupot Creek
rows.description: Lungsod ng Quezon.

rows.name: Canal de Balete / Estero De Balete
rows.description: Isang lagusan ng tubig sa Ermita, Maynila na dumadaan sa 4 na mga Barangay: 660, 660A, 661, at 664 ng Zone 71, District V. Ang Canal De Balete o kilala bilang Estero De Balete ay may haba na 550 na metro. Katabi nito ang Estero De Provisor at nagtatapos sa Ilog Pasig.

rows.name: Canal de la Reina (Estero de la Reina)
rows.description: Nagmumula ang tubig mula sa Manila hanggang Kalye Tayuman, Abenida Recto, at Binondo. Nagtatapos sa Binondo at mayroong estasyon sa kahabaan ng Muelle de Binondo. Nagtatapos sa Ilog Pasig sa katimugang punto nito. Nagtatapos sa Look ng Maynila sa daanan ng Estero de Vitas sa hilagang punto nito.

rows.name: Centerville Creek
rows.description: Lungsod ng Quezon.

rows.name: Culiat Creek
rows.description: Lungsod ng Quezon.

rows.name: Dampalit River
rows.description: Nagmumula ang tubig sa Malabon at Navotas at nagtatapos sa Ilog Tangos.

rows.name: Dario River
rows.description: Lungsod ng Quezon. Tributaryo ng Ilog San Francisco.

rows.name: Dilimán Creek
rows.description: Lungsod ng Quezon.

rows.name: Estero de Concordia
rows.description: Pandacan.

rows.name: Estero de Magdalena
rows.description: Tondo.

rows.name: Estero de Maypad
rows.description: Nagmumula ang tubig mula sa Maynila, Navotas at Caloocan. Nagtatapos sa Ilog Navotas.

rows.name: Estero de Meysig
rows.description: Binondo. Ngayon bahagi ng Estero de Magdalena.

rows.name: Estero de Paco
rows.description: Nagmumula ang tubig mula Paco at Pandacan. Konektado sa kaliwang pampang ng Ilog Pasig.

rows.name: Estero de Pandacan
rows.description: Nagmumula ang tubig mula Paco at Pandacan. Nagtatapos sa Ilog Pasig.

rows.name: Estero de Sampaloc
rows.description: Minor tributary of the Pasig River. Forms confluence with Estero de Aviles in its end.

rows.name: Estero de San Antonio Abad
rows.description: Malate. North of Fort San Antonio Abad

rows.name: Estero de San Jacinto
rows.description: Now part of Estero de la Reina.

rows.name: Estero de San Lazaro
rows.description: Tondó.

rows.name: Estero de San Miguel
rows.description: Located in the Manila district of San Miguel along its boundary with Quiapo, Sampaloc and Santa Mesa. Drains into Pasig River.

rows.name: Estero de Santa Cruz
rows.description: Santa Cruz.

rows.name: Estero de San Sebastian
rows.description: Quiapo.

rows.name: Estero de Santa Clara
rows.description: Santa Ana-Makati.

rows.name: Estero de Santibañez
rows.description: Pandacan.

rows.name: Estero de Sunog Apog
rows.description: Drains water from Manila. Dumps water to Manila Bay via Estero de Vitas.

rows.name: Estero de Tanque
rows.description: Paco.

rows.name: Estero de Tripa de Gallina
rows.description: Drains water from Manila (Paco and San Andres), Makati as far as Forbes Park and Fort Bonifacio and then through Gil Puyat Avenue in Makati and Pasay (including Bangkal and Don Bosco Makati) and then in Parañaque. Dumps water into Manila Bay via the Parañaque River at an intersection near western side of the NAIA runway.

rows.name: Estero de Trozo
rows.description: Binondo. now part of Estero de San Lazaro

rows.name: Estero de Valencia
rows.description: Drains water from Sampaloc and Santa Mesa, Manila. Dumps water to Pasig River.

rows.name: Estero de Vitas
rows.description: Drains water from Manila (as far as Tayuman Street). Dumps water directly to Manila Bay.

rows.name: Gabe Creek
rows.description: Lungsod ng Quezon.

rows.name: Ilang Ilang Creek
rows.description: Barangay Santa Monica, Quezon City.

rows.name: Kalamiong Creek
rows.description: Barangay Payatas, Quezon City.

rows.name: Kamias Creek
rows.description: Quezon City. Tributary of the Dilimán Creek.

rows.name: Katipunan Creek
rows.description: Lungsod ng Quezon.

rows.name: Laguna River
rows.description: Major channel. Drains water from Makati, Pateros, and Taguig. Dumps water into Laguna de Bay.

rows.name: Las Piñas River
rows.description: Major channel. Drains water from Las Piñas and dumps it directly to Manila Bay.

rows.name: Magdaong River
rows.description: Drains water from Muntinlupa. Dumps water into Laguna de Bay.

rows.name: Mangangate River
rows.description: Drains water from Alabang and Ayala Alabang in Muntinlupa and empties into the Laguna de Bay.

rows.name: Mariblo Creek
rows.description: Lungsod ng Quezon.

rows.name: Marikina River
rows.description: Major channel. Drains water from Marikina, Cainta, Rodriguez, San Mateo and Antipolo in Rizal. as well as some parts of Quezon City. It leads to Pasig River.

rows.name: Marilao River
rows.description: Major channel. Drains water from Marilao, Meycauayan and as far as the northwestern side of the La Mesa Dam area. Two other rivers, the Meycuayan River and Polo River that drains Malabon and Valenzuela dump their water here. Another great rivers, the Santa Maria River and Balagtas River meet up with the Marilao River in the Obando area before reaching Manila Bay.

rows.name: Matalahib Creek
rows.description: Quezon City.

rows.name: Maytunas Creek
rows.description: Drains Mandaluyong and San Juan. Dumps water into San Juan River.

rows.name: Meycauayan River
rows.description: Major channel. Drains water from Valenzuela and Meycauayan in Bulacan. Dumps water into Manila Bay via Marilao River.

rows.name: Muzon River
rows.description: Drains water from Malabon and Bulacan. Dumps water to Manila Bay via the entrance of Marilao River in Bulacan.

rows.name: Nangka River
rows.description: Tributary of Marikina River.

rows.name: Navotas River
rows.description: Major channel. Drains water from Navotas, Caloocan and Manila. Intersects with Tullahan River at the middle. Dumps water directly to Manila Bay (southern end) and to Tangos River (northern end).

rows.name: Paltok Creek
rows.description: Barangay Fairview, Quezon City.

rows.name: Pansól Creek
rows.description: Quezon City.

rows.name: Parañaque River
rows.description: Major channel. Drains Parañaque, Pasay and Manila areas. Dumps water directly into Manila Bay.

rows.name: Pasig River
rows.description: Major channel. Drains water from Laguna de Bay and Marikina River, and also Makati, Mandaluyong, Manila, Quezon City and San Juan (including San Juan River). Dumps water directly to Manila Bay.

rows.name: Pasong Diablo River
rows.description: Drains water from Alabang, Muntinlupa. Dumps water into Laguna de Bay.

rows.name: Pasong Tamo Creek
rows.description: Quezon City.

rows.name: Pateros River
rows.description: Major channel. Drains water from Pateros and Makati area (Guadalupe and Bonifacio Global City). Dumps most of its water into Laguna de Bay via Laguna River at its southeastern tip. Dumps some of its water into Pasig River in Guadalupe.

rows.name: Pingkian Creek
rows.description: Quezon City.

rows.name: Poblacion River
rows.description: Drains water from Muntinlupa (Poblacion). Dumps water into Laguna de Bay.

rows.name: Polo River
rows.description: Alternatively known as Santolan River. Drains water from Malabon, Valenzuela and Bulacan. Connects both Tullahan and Meycauayan Rivers.

rows.name: Salapan River
rows.description: Quezon City.

rows.name: San Francisco River
rows.description: Quezon City.

rows.name: San Juan River
rows.description: Major channel. Drains water from Quezon City (including Tandang Sora and as far as Sauyo and Fairview), San Juan and Manila. Dumps water into Pasig River.

rows.name: Sapang Baho River
rows.description: Its headwaters are in the Sierra Madre in Antipolo crossing the northern portion of Marikina and nearby municipalities in Rizal before emptying into the Laguna de Bay.

rows.name: Satopan Creek
rows.description: Quezon City. Tributary of the San Juan River.

rows.name: Sucat River
rows.description: Major channel. Drains water from Parañaque and Muntinlupa. Dumps water into Laguna de Bay.

rows.name: Tangos River
rows.description: Drains water from Navotas. Dumps water directly to Manila Bay.

rows.name: Tangue Creek
rows.description: Quezon City.

rows.name: Tanza River
rows.description: Drains water from Navotas. Connects with Dampalit River. Dumps water to Tangos River.

rows.name: Tullahan River
rows.description: Major channel. Drains water from La Mesa Dam, as well as the northern part of Quezon City, Valenzuela, Malabon and Navotas. Mouth is at Navotas.

rows.name: Tunasan River
rows.description: Drains water from Muntinlupa. Dumps water into Laguna de Bay.

rows.name: Ilog Zapote
rows.description: Major channel. Drains water from Las Piñas and parts of Bacoor, Cavite. Dumps water into Manila Bay directly.
